messages:
maya: Heads-up: post-launch backlog review. Customers leaking through search flows and a handful of perf regressions. We need a simple rule-set to lock a 2-week urgent patch train and a second pass for enhancements. I grouped items by signal and added rough impact estimates in the sheet: https://tiny.redwood/backlogan we decide criteria + owners quickly?

ajay: yep. Triage criteria should be deterministic. suggest severity + customer-impact + regression flag. no long debates.

courtney: quick rubric draft: 
````
sev-0: system data loss / major outage -> immediate bugfix
sev-1: core user journey broken for >200 users or an enterprise blocker -> hotfix
sev-2: degraded performance / incorrect but tolerable UX -> schedule in next sprint
sev-3: suggestion / polish / minor UX request -> backlog grooming
````
courtney: Also: mark anything labeled "billing" or "consistency" as at least sev-1.

ben: + add: if a ticket is a regression from last shipped tag -> bump one sev (unless it's a tiny cosmetic).

sara: i'll own canary strategy for hotfixes. we need a rollback bullet per PR. also propose automated smoke script to run pre-canary.

maya: thanks. assigning hotfix owners for the top 5 tickets: ajay (cache invalidation), ben (search ranking fix), sara (db migration edge-case), ajay (profile sync bug), oliver (rate limit miscount). remaining items go to enhancement queue.

ajay: noted. @release-bot can you reserve a canary slot tomorrow morning? also we'll need infra help for tracing during canary.

release-bot: Canary slot reserved: 2026-04-15 08:30-09:30 UTC for team product-hotfix. Please add label `hotfix/canary` to PRs and include smoke test results in PR description.

oliver: For enhancements, i'd like a "fast win" tag for work <= 3 dev-days vs "investigations" for anything > 3 dev-days. Fast wins to queue in next sprint, investigations get a 3-day spike.

courtney: +1. also require an acceptance metric (e.g., <200ms p95 on query) or a clear UX target for each enhancement. avoids vague scope.

ben: i'll sketch the roll-forward/rollback checklist and test cases tonight. putting steps in the ticket.

maya: plan: update backlog sheet with columns: severity, regression, owner, delivery track (hotfix/fast-win/investigation), acceptance criteria, canary window. Hotfix sprint = 2w starting Monday; enhancements queued for the following sprint. Owners please add estimated effort and a short rollout plan to each ticket by EOD.

ajay: will do. flagging one ticket that I think should be sev-0 (profile corruption)  can we escalate?

courtney: saw that, maya if you agree bump now or we'll miss patch window.

maya: bumping it to sev-0 and tagging @ben and @sara for immediate attention. Thanks team. :rocket:
